bullets.title: Slipped after data
bullets.text: Kitco had spot gold at 3,845.26 at 16:06 SAST, near the session low, after it hit 3,887.60 earlier in the day.

bullets.title: Retail sales mixed
bullets.text: October retail sales rose 0.2% as expected, but the core group rose 0.6% against 0.4% forecast, which supports more Fed hikes (Kitco, Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Price unconfirmed now
bullets.text: No price newer than 16:06 SAST was confirmed; Trading Economics showed about 3,869 at an unstated time, so the live price is UNVERIFIED.

bullets.title: Hike nearly priced
bullets.text: Kitco cites 96.6% odds of a December quarter-point hike; Trading Economics shows about 93%, so the exact figure differs by source.

bullets.title: Dollar eased slightly
bullets.text: The dollar index slipped about 0.13% to 103.42 from a 19-month high and the 10-year yield is near 5.10%, still a headwind for gold (Trading Economics).

bullets.title: Near one-year low
bullets.text: Gold is just above Monday's low near 3,830-3,833, its weakest since about September-October 2025.

bullets.title: FOMC minutes next
bullets.text: Wednesday's FOMC minutes at 21:00 SAST can move gold fast if they sound more hawkish.
